source: Compiled by Tiwalade Joanna Okedara-Kalu while building Shopinbos (2026). Notes reflect her own experience, not a ranking.

extra.name: CAC VAS API
extra.note: Worked in testing, then checks failed in production. Support form, chatbot and phone calls didn't resolve it. Backup identity providers were added.

extra.name: Africa's Talking
extra.note: Calls and SMS have been reliable.

services.what: for TikTok Login and posting videos.

services.name: Meta Business verification
services.what: unlocks WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and ads. Needs a CAC certificate, a utility bill and a website.
services.note: Gate in front of WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook messaging and ads. Needs a CAC certificate, a utility bill in the business name and a matching website. If any don't line up, you wait.

services.what: needs CAC documents, director IDs and a business bank account.
services.note: Solid. Split payments let money go straight to the seller's own bank through a subaccount.

services.name: SMS sender ID
services.what: so texts arrive from "Shopinbos", not a random number. Approval takes days.
services.note: Approval takes days. Build with a fallback SMS provider from day one.
